tracks.name: music_menu
tracks.prompt: Calm, warm acoustic instrumental: fingerpicked steel-string guitar and kantele (Finnish zither), gentle and unhurried, nostalgic Nordic folk mood, a quiet evening in a summer forest by a lake. No drums, no vocals. Consistent dynamics from start to end, no intro, no ending, no fade-out.

tracks.name: music_easy
tracks.prompt: Upbeat, bright instrumental folk-pop for a bicycle adventure through a Finnish summer forest: acoustic guitar strumming, mandolin melody, light brushed drums, warm bass, playful and optimistic, 120 bpm. No vocals. Steady energy throughout, no slow intro, no fade-out ending.

tracks.name: music_mid
tracks.prompt: Driving instrumental indie folk-rock at 135 bpm: acoustic and clean electric guitar riffs, banjo, punchy drums, bass, determined adventurous mood like mountain biking fast on a rocky forest trail, Nordic melodic flavor. No vocals. Consistent energy, no slow intro, no fade-out ending.

tracks.name: music_hard
tracks.prompt: Intense, fast instrumental rock at 150 bpm: distorted guitar riff, driving drums, energetic bass, the adrenaline of a steep rocky downhill mountain bike run, Nordic melodic flavor with a touch of folk fiddle. No vocals. Consistent high energy from start to end, no slow intro, no fade-out ending.

tracks.name: music_win
tracks.prompt: Short triumphant celebratory instrumental fanfare: bright acoustic guitar, kantele, glockenspiel and a cheerful drum roll leading into a happy folk melody, the feeling of arriving at a lakeside cottage after a long ride. No vocals. Starts immediately at full energy.

tracks.name: music_dusk
tracks.prompt: Atmospheric, mysterious driving instrumental at 130 bpm for riding a mountain bike through a Finnish forest at twilight: pulsing analog synth bass, steady soft drums, echoing clean electric guitar arpeggios, kantele plucks, a melancholic Nordic melody, cinematic dusk mood with a sense of forward motion. No vocals. Consistent energy throughout, no slow intro, no fade-out ending.

tracks.name: music_night
tracks.prompt: Dark, tense, fast instrumental at 148 bpm for a night ride through a pitch-black forest by headlamp: deep throbbing synth bass, tight fast drums, distorted guitar stabs, eerie high synth textures and a lone folk fiddle line, urgent Nordic melody, suspenseful and relentless. No vocals. Consistent high energy from start to end, no slow intro, no fade-out ending.

voice_persona: You are the voice of Petri, a 45-year-old Finnish mountain biker: a warm, slightly gruff Finnish man, natural spoken Finnish, no accent. Say EXACTLY the following Finnish line and nothing else, no extra words, no explanation. Delivery: {style}. Line: "{text}"

voices.name: voice_crash1
voices.style: a sharp pained yelp right as he falls off the bike

voices.name: voice_crash3
voices.style: pained and grumbling after a crash, quick

voices.name: voice_land1
voices.style: a short effort grunt while absorbing a hard landing

voices.name: voice_start
voices.style: determined and cheerful, starting a ride

voices.name: voice_bog
voices.style: disgusted, bike sinking into a bog, quick

voices.name: voice_done
voices.style: joyful, out of breath, arriving at the cottage

voices.name: voice_dusk
voices.style: calm but a little wary, switching on his headlamp as dusk falls

voices.name: voice_night
voices.style: quiet, focused, slightly tense, about to ride into the dark

voices.name: voice_hop
voices.style: quick, urging himself to lift the front wheel over a ledge, effortful

voices.name: voice_owl
voices.style: a soft amused remark to himself, noticing an owl
